product_overview: Ryan Kroge’s website is a public-facing lead generation and education platform for SBA loans, business acquisition financing, and strategic financial guidance. It helps visitors learn about financing options and connect through a contact form, calendar booking, or AI-powered callback request.
core_goals: Educate prospective clients about SBA loan options and related financing strategies
Build trust through professional background, testimonials, FAQs, and resource content
Capture qualified leads through the contact form and AI callback request
Enable visitors to book a call directly from the site
Allow authenticated admins to manage published resource posts

features.name: Public Website Navigation and Service Discovery
features.description: Visitors can browse the main marketing pages to learn about Ryan Kroge, his financing services, and available resources.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review the homepage sections -> Open the About page -> Review Ryan’s background and approach
Navigate to / -> Explore the services overview -> Open the SBA Loans page -> Review loan types and eligibility guidance
Navigate to / -> Explore the services overview -> Open the Business Acquisition page -> Review acquisition financing guidance
Navigate to / -> Explore the services overview -> Open the Strategic Financial Guidance page -> Review advisory services
Navigate to /resources -> Browse the list of published resources -> Open a resource post -> Read the full article -> Return to the resources list

features.name: Homepage Engagement Experience
features.description: The homepage presents the primary value proposition and interactive sections that guide visitors toward the next action.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review the hero message -> Start the application journey -> Arrive at the contact page
Navigate to / -> Select explore services -> Jump to the services section -> Review the available service options
Navigate to / -> Move through the testimonial carousel -> See different testimonials as the carousel advances
Navigate to / -> Open FAQ items one at a time -> Read answers to common financing questions
Navigate to / -> Review the final call to action -> Choose to start the application or book a call

features.name: Contact Form Lead Capture
features.description: Visitors can submit their contact details and financing needs through a lead form that records their inquiry.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in first name, last name, email, phone, loan purpose, and message -> Check consent to be contacted -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation
Navigate to /contact -> Leave required form fields empty -> Submit the form -> See validation messages for missing information

features.name: AI Callback Request
features.description: Visitors can request an immediate AI-powered outbound phone call by providing their name and phone number.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Enter name and phone number -> Start the AI call request -> See the call request submitted and a callback initiated
Navigate to /contact -> Enter name with an invalid or missing phone number -> Start the AI call request -> See validation feedback for the phone number

features.name: Calendar Booking
features.description: Visitors can schedule a meeting through the embedded booking calendar on the contact page.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> View the embedded calendar booking experience -> Choose an available meeting time -> Proceed with booking

features.name: Authenticated Resource Management
features.description: An admin user can manage resource posts through a protected dashboard with create, edit, and delete actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Sign in with Supabase credentials -> View the list of resource posts
Navigate to /admin -> Sign in with Supabase credentials -> Create a new post with a title and rich text content -> Save the post -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /admin -> Sign in with Supabase credentials -> Open an existing post -> Edit the post content -> Save changes -> See the updated post in the list
Navigate to /admin -> Sign in with Supabase credentials -> Delete a post -> See it removed from the list

routes.description: Landing page with hero, services overview, testimonials, and FAQs
Information about Ryan Kroge, experience, and philosophy
Details about SBA loan options and eligibility
Information on using SBA loans for business acquisition
Details on strategic financial guidance services
Contact form, AI call integration, and booking calendar
Admin panel to manage resource posts

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Form to capture leads, stored in Supabase
user_interactions: Fill First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone

features.name: AI Call Initiation
features.description: Trigger an outbound call via Retell AI

features.name: Resource Management
user_interactions: Create new post with title and rich text content

known_limitations.impact: Prevents rapid re-submission, testing may hit rate limits
